Subject: Observability staging rollout matrix & implementation kickoff

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the SignalWorks integration. Per our call this week, I'm kicking off the implementation thread to align roles, staging rollout windows, and the set of observability hooks we'll need for go-live validation.

High-level asks for this thread:
- Confirm who will own data-plane tracing and who will ship the first tracing sample (span IDs, service names) into our staging environment.
- Confirm staging windows (UTC) for the initial rollout and smoke validation.
- Review the attached 'observability-rollout-matrix.xlsx' for responsibilities and expected deliverables.

Attachments: observability-rollout-matrix.xlsx (owner matrix + timeline)
Also attaching a short snippet with our recommended tracing hook examples in 'redwood-tracing-hook-snippets.md'.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm owners and preferred staging windows by EOD Monday.
2) We schedule a 45m pairing session with your infra lead and our runtime team to validate trace headers and prefix caching behavior.
3) Ben will share specific tracing hook snippets and an alert routing suggestion after pairing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Kimberly Park | kimberly.park@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0147

Kimberly,

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers from our side:
- Owner: I will own coordination. Our infra lead is Mark Rivera (mark.rivera@signalworks.com) and he will be the trace owner.
- Staging windows: preferred windows are 2028-11-15 02:00-05:00 UTC for the initial deploy and 2028-11-17 02:00-04:00 UTC for smoke.
- We reviewed the matrix briefly — two clarifying questions:
  1) Does Redwood expect our staging spans to include full user_id in attributes, or just a hashed identifier? We have PII rules that prefer hashed ids in traces.
  2) For alert routing, can you propose a default escalation (PagerDuty) mapping for Sev1/Sev2?

I'll cc Mark on the pairing session request after I confirm his availability.

Best,
Aisha

On Fri, Nov 9, 2028 at 11:03 AM Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@signalworks.com> wrote:
> Kimberly,
>
> Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers from our side:
> - Owner: I will own coordination. Our infra lead is Mark Rivera...

Thanks Aisha — that works. Short answers to your clarifying questions:
- Tracing PII: Redwood recommends hashed identifiers in traces for staging and production. We'll accept either a hashed user_id or a short opaque user_token. Ben has included example snippets in the attached 'redwood-tracing-hook-snippets.md'.
- Alert routing: default suggestion below — we'll finalize during pairing:
  * Sev1 (service down / catastrophic errors): PagerDuty -> oncall-platform -> paging every 5 minutes, also email to infra-leads@signalworks.com
  * Sev2 (degraded performance / widespread errors): Slack #sw-platform-alerts + email to infra-leads
  * Sev3 (single-customer or minor errors): ticket to Jira queue JIRA-OPS-4123 and daily digest

Proposed pairing slots (PST time converted to UTC in matrix):
- Mon 2028-11-13 17:00-17:45 PST (Mon 2028-11-14 01:00-01:45 UTC)
- Tue 2028-11-14 10:00-10:45 PST (Tue 2028-11-14 18:00-18:45 UTC)

Ben — can you confirm you'll own the tracingsample validation and post the alert-routing stub after the pairing? Rishi and Mark, please add any constraints on rate-limiting for staging traffic.

Thanks,
Kim

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@signalworks.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability staging rollout matrix & implementation kickoff

Putting in the technical details now so Mark's team can validate quickly. Snippets below (full file attached as redwood-tracing-hook-snippets.md):

- Tracing header: we support 'x-redwood-trace' and prefer W3C Trace Context (traceparent). Sample header to inject on staging: 
  traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01

- Example minimal span attributes (JSON):
  {service.name: "signalworks-frontend", span.kind: "server", redwood.user_id_hashed: "sha256(...)"}

- Error taxonomy (staging focus):
  * Err-API-Auth: token failures / invalid signature (route to Sev2)
  * Err-Model-Timeout: model inference exceeded 10s (route to Sev2 + autoscale check)
  * Err-Serialization: payload deserialization failure (route to Sev3)

- Alert routing stub (will publish as a short YAML in the Drive):
  sev1: pagerduty: redwood-sev1, notify: infra-leads@signalworks.com
  sev2: slack: #sw-platform-alerts, create_jira: JIRA-OPS-4123
  sev3: create_jira: JIRA-OPS-4123, notify: engineering-digest@signalworks.com

I'll upload the alert YAML and small test harness for generating a sample trace to the shared Drive (link below). Mark — once you confirm the header and span attributes, I'll push a test trace from our staging injector and ping the channel.

--
Ben Carter
Technical Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@signalworks.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mark.rivera@signalworks.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>

Kim, Ben — this looks good. Mark validated the traceparent header and hashed user_id approach; we're comfortable with the snippets. We've created a Jira ticket (JIRA-OPS-4123) for the pairing work and alert routing implementation. I've also shared a Drive folder with Mark's team and given Redwoods the folder link.

Action items we own:
- Mark to join pairing session and provide staging credentials.
- We will hash user_id on our side and expose redwood.user_id_hashed in spans.
- Confirmed staging windows (11/15 and 11/17 UTC slots).

Ben: please upload the YAML and test harness today so Mark can validate before pairing.

Thanks,
Aisha
